items.title: 5U AI scales up new digital workforce platform - American Journal of Transportation
items.summary: “We are not building another chatbot that answers questions and disappears, we are building AI Workers that understand freight operations, carry out the work, and capture the reasoning behind every decision, so teams can scale their knowledge as well as their capacity.”. 5U AI works inside existing freight systems and uses multi-agent AI trained for logistics workflows, including the complex exceptions and manual decisions that make forwarding operations difficult to automate with generic AI tools or legacy automation. The company is already live with forwarders and carriers across Europe, including with TCI International Logistics, where its AI Workers are being used across air and ocean freight operations. 5U AI is growing its team as part of the scale-up, with plans to hire across product, engineering, operations, commercial, and customer functions. “AI is one of the most exciting developments logistics has seen for a generation, but its value will depend on people who understand the industry and want to build practical tools that solve real operational problems,” said Abik.

items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

items.title: 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development' - Business Insider
items.summary: # Over 1,100 AI workers sign letter asking US to support tools that 'pace the frontier of automated AI development'. Senior officials at some of the nation's leading AI companies say it's time for the federal government to find a way to put the brakes on AI development if it's needed. "We request that the U.S. government support an international effort to develop the technical and governance tools needed to deliberately pace the frontier of automated AI development," reads an open letter signed by more than 1,100 AI workers from companies including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta. The letter zeroes in on "automated AI development," which refers to when AI will be capable of developing itself, something the industry calls "Recursive Self-Improvement." Anthropic has shared that its Claude models are quickly approaching that threshold. Look out for an alert in your inbox the next time a new story is published!

items.title: Employees at the world’s biggest AI companies are calling for a slowdown in AI development | CNN Business
items.summary:
OpenAI said in a statement to CNN they agree with potentially pacing the development of AI, adding they “hope to contribute to work led by the U.S. government, alongside other labs” on the topic.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman suggested it may be time to slow down AI development in a podcast interview Tuesday. The OpenAI models that broke out of their test environment are fueling “long term questions” about how AI companies should address this new rate of progress. [...] The letter comes on the heels of major advancements and burgeoning threats from rapidly developing AI systems. OpenAI disclosed last week that two of its test models escaped a lab environment, bypassed its systems to gain access to the open internet and hacked a different company’s internal system. [...] “[T]here is a real risk that capability development rapidly accelerates beyond our ability to understand or control the resulting systems,” the signees said. “To realize AI’s potential, industry, government, and society at large may need the option to buy time to address emerging risks, develop security measures, and strengthen oversight.”

Hoạt động hỏi đáp, tư vấn trực tiếp cũng giúp các doanh nghiệp, tổ chức và chuyên gia tăng cường kết nối, chia sẻ kinh nghiệm và tìm kiếm cơ hội hợp tác.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân (có thể là bất kỳ số thực nào).

**Giải thích:** Theo quy tắc tích phân lũy thừa $\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C$ (với $n \neq -1$), ta có $n = 2$, nên $n+1 = 3$ và kết quả là $\frac{x^3}{3} + C$.

results.input: Bạn là gì và làm được những gì?

result.actual_text:
Tôi là một trợ lý nghiên cứu (research assistant) có khả năng truy xuất thông tin từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau. Dưới đây là những gì tôi làm được:

## 🔧 Các công cụ chính

| Công cụ | Dùng khi nào |
|---------|--------------|
| **`lookup`** | Tìm kiếm thông tin trên web (tin tức, kiến thức chung) |
| **`social_search`** | Tìm bài đăng trên mạng xã hội theo chủ đề/từ khóa |
| **`timeline`** | Lấy bài đăng gần đây của một người cụ thể (cần @handle) |
| **`fetch`** | Đọc nội dung từ một URL cụ thể |
| **`papers` / `paper_text`** | Tìm và đọc bài báo khoa học (arXiv) |
| **`policy`** | Tra cứu quy định nội bộ công ty |
| **`format`** | Trình bày dữ liệu thành bản tóm tắt/digest |
| **`send`** | Gửi nội dung đi (cần xác nhận trước) |
| **`clarify`** | Hỏi thêm thông tin khi thiếu dữ liệu |

## 📋 Ví dụ yêu cầu tôi xử lý tốt

- *"Tìm tin tức AI tuần này"* → `lookup` (topic=news, timeframe=week)
- *"Người ta nói gì về GPT-5 trên Twitter?"* → `social_search`
- *"Bài tweet mới nhất của @sama"* → `timeline` (screenname=sama)
- *"Đọc giúp tôi link này: https://..."* → `fetch`
- *"Tóm tắt paper attention is all you need"* → `papers` + `paper_text`
- *"So sánh 2 bài báo này và gửi cho tôi"* → `fetch` x2 → `format` → `clarify(yes_no)` → `send`

## ⚠️ Những gì tôi **KHÔNG** làm
- Giải toán, viết code, trả lời kiến thức chung không cần tìm kiếm
- Đoán handle Twitter hoặc bịa URL — sẽ hỏi lại bằng `clarify`
- Gửi tin nhắn mà không có sự xác nhận rõ ràng

---

items.title: Moburst develops AI engine optimization capabilities for established companies - TechCrunch
items.summary: Mobile growth agency Moburst has built out a dedicated AI Engine Optimization practice aimed at established companies with existing app portfolios, betting that the category still lacks agencies with real depth rather than a rebranded service page. AI Engine Optimization, more commonly abbreviated AEO for Answer Engine Optimization, is the practice of structuring a brand’s content and web presence so AI systems such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google’s AI Overviews can confidently cite it when answering a user’s question directly, rather than showing a ranked list of links. For established companies vetting an AEO partner, the practical test is whether the agency can point to specific app-store-side work, not just web content changes, and whether it can describe a concrete process for reconciling inconsistent brand descriptions across many independent sources rather than treating that as someone else’s problem.

results.input: Viết giúp mình một hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là hàm Python tính Fibonacci bằng recursion:

```python
def fibonacci(n):
    """
    Tính số Fibonacci thứ n bằng recursion.
    
    Args:
        n (int): Vị trí trong dãy Fibonacci (bắt đầu từ 0)
        
    Returns:
        int: Số Fibonacci tại vị trí n
    """
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    else:
        return fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2)


# Ví dụ sử dụng
if __name__ == "__main__":
    for i in range(10):
        print(f"F({i}) = {fibonacci(i)}")
```

**Kết quả:**
```
F(0) = 0
F(1) = 1
F(2) = 1
F(3) = 2
F(4) = 3
F(5) = 5
F(6) = 8
F(7) = 13
F(8) = 21
F(9) = 34
```

---

⚠️ **Lưu ý về hiệu năng:** Cách này có độ phức tạp thời gian **O(2ⁿ)** do tính toán lặp lại nhiều lần. Với `n` lớn (>35), sẽ rất chậm.

**Các cách tối ưu:**

1. **Memoization (đệ quy + cache):**
```python
from functools import lru_cache

@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fibonacci_memo(n):
    if n <= 0:
        return 0
    elif n == 1:
        return 1
    return fibonacci_memo(n - 1) + fibonacci_memo(n - 2)
```

2. **Iterative (khuyên dùng cho n lớn):**
```python
def fibonacci_iter(n):
    a, b = 0, 1
    for _ in range(n):
        a, b = b, a + b
    return a
```

Cách iterative có độ phức tạp **O(n)** và **O(1)** bộ nhớ.

Unlike autonomous driving or industrial robotics, healthcare robotics can’t rely on internet-scale data collection or unlimited real-world experimentation. Every demonstration requires specialized equipment, clinical expertise, and access to patients or laboratory environments. This creates three fundamental challenges for developers. [...] The third challenge is development velocity. Medical robotics development relies on benchtop phantoms, cadaver studies, animal models, and limited clinical evaluations. items.title: OpenAI is launching new corporate software that takes it beyond the AI model war - Business Insider
items.summary: # OpenAI is launching new corporate software that takes it beyond the AI model war. OpenAI is launching a new product that could help the company take another step beyond the ultra-competitive business of making AI models. The offering, called OpenAI Presence, helps companies run AI agents better by connecting these systems to internal corporate data, policies, existing software, and workflows. This is the latest example of OpenAI trying to move beyond selling access to AI models and into more parts of the corporate software market.While Presence could help OpenAI win more corporate business, it could also leave the startup competing with some of its AI model customers. If that's the direction OpenAI is taking, it increasingly looks less like a model company and more like an enterprise software provider with AI at its core. items.title: OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack - BBC
items.summary: # OpenAI says its AI went rogue and launched 'unprecedented' cyber-attack. OpenAI has revealed some of its most advanced AI models went rogue and hacked a start-up after it lost control of them during a security test. The ChatGPT-maker said its agents - AI bots which can operate alone after some human instruction – were being tested in a controlled environment, but found vulnerabilities and managed to escape. OpenAI said the incident was "unprecedented", and it was working with Hugging Face to investigate what happened and strengthen safeguards. Gina Neff, head of the Minderoo Centre for Technology and Democracy at the University of Cambridge, told BBC Radio 4's Today programme that the security tests - called sandboxes - are "supposed to be secure environments where you can see what the models are capable of". Once outside, the AI identified Hugging Face as a likely source of the answers they were seeking in the test, and tried to gain access.

items.title: OpenAI promotes Sia to Advanced Partner in its OpenAI Partner Network - Consultancy.eu
items.summary: # OpenAI promotes Sia to Advanced Partner in its OpenAI Partner Network. ***OpenAI, the company behind ChatGPT and a suite of enterprise AI solutions, has named Sia an Advanced Partner within its OpenAI Partner Network.***. The recognition reflects the consultancy’s track record in helping organisations adopt and scale AI solutions, and its ability to drive enterprise-wide transformation through AI technologies. Launched last month, the OpenAI Partner Network brings together a select group of global consulting and technology firms to accelerate the adoption of OpenAI solutions at scale. Only a limited number of organisations were appointed as Founding Partners, including Accenture, Bain & Company, Boston Consulting Group, McKinsey & Company, PwC, Capgemini, EY and Sia. Sia is now among the first of the cohort to achieve Advanced Partner status, recognising its expertise in integrating ChatGPT Enterprise, Codex and OpenAI’s models into daily operations. “Becoming an OpenAI Advanced Partner reflects our ambition to help organisations move beyond AI experimentation and achieve enterprise-wide transformation,” said Matthieu Courtecuisse, CEO and Founder of Sia.
